title: From fringe to mainstream: Is it still taboo to vote National Rally?
summary: The Marine Le Pen verdict is just the latest challenge for her National Rally party and its quest to be seen as a widely accepted, mainstream party. France24's Solange Mougin dives into the party's normalisation strategies. From "dédiabolisation," to softening anti-semitism rhetoric, to feminism, to necktie wearing, the efforts are working.
